name: 白羽教団の大聖城

placement.note: The forecourt floor is 13.4 m above the model base (the outer walls continue down to an apron); placed 13.4 m below the terrain so the forecourt meets the valley floor.

notes: Rebuilt 2026-09-13 as a stepped temple-fortress: a walled forecourt behind a collapsed arch gate, three progressively smaller roofless terraces and a summit altar with a ruined throne, joined by grand central stairs and side stairs; the crow cult is fought one level at a time with the pontiff on the summit. Full mesh shared; the coarse LODs are not adopted.

provenance.provider: Codex CLI image_gen reference (gpt-5.6-sol, medium) and local TRELLIS-2; reduction, walk atlas and integration by Claude Code
provenance.referencePrompt: Ruined stepped temple-fortress of five ascending open terraces: a broad walled forecourt behind a collapsed arch gate, three progressively smaller roofless terraces stacked like a ziggurat, and a small summit altar platform with a ruined throne dais and four broken pillars; every level joined by one grand central stair and two flanking side stairs. User request 2026-09-13: rebuild the crow cult's castle so it is wider, climbed by many stairs in stages, with the pontiff at the very top. Candidate 01 of two Codex image_gen references selected by Claude Code (user not available); candidate 02 retained as history.
provenance.reconstruction: Local TRELLIS-2 1024 seed 42 (reference v4); shape-preserving quadric reduction at p95 0.065 m to 127254 triangles with the source UV and albedo.

normalUpgrade.method: Tangent-space normal map baked from the TRELLIS dense surface (similarity-ICP placed on the delivered mesh, scripts/remake/fit_to_delivered.py) onto the delivered UVs and normals (scripts/remake/normal_upgrade.py), injected as an appended WebP image + normalTexture (scripts/remake/inject_normal_map.py). Geometry bytes unchanged.
